checkpoint_audits.notes: Gated, four-shard dense Llama checkpoint with Llama-3 RoPE and a 156940-token byte-BPE vocabulary.
Safe Hugging Face conversion; 269 tensors map exactly to the pinned SNAC graph.

limitations: The reference Orpheus checkpoint is gated and requires accepted model access.
Native loading supports dense Llama Safetensors checkpoints; GGUF, quantized tensors, mixture-of-experts, and non-Llama Orpheus derivatives are rejected.
SNAC loading intentionally uses the immutable Safetensors conversion rather than the unsafe pickle checkpoint on the repository's main revision.
policy: Architecture and tokenizer execution are VoiceHub-owned; pretrained weights remain external and are loaded through strict Safetensors adapters.
